text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Born(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Premises:
¬Novel(podcast) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (Born(x, AmericanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Book(x) ∧ Novel(x)) → (WrittenBy(y, x) → Writer(y))) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ Publish(familyHistory, year2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
Born(boston, AmericanCity) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
¬Novel(familySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is not a novel.
